rawFindings.title: Incorrect or incomplete handling of home path patterns in isHomeHelper
rawFindings.explanation: The original code correctly handled empty path and 'index.html' as home. The new code only checks if path === '' and no longer treats 'index.html' as home. This changes expected behavior and might break valid home path detection. Also, the regex pattern was modified from including optional 'index.html' suffix to excluding it, potentially failing to match valid pagination paths ending with 'index.html'.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the check for path being empty or 'index.html': if (!this.path || this.path === 'index.html') return true; Also, change the regex back to include optional '(index\.html)?$' at the end to match pagination paths ending with or without 'index.html'.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of empty path in isHomeHelper
rawFindings.explanation: The check for empty path or 'index.html' has been replaced with only an empty string check. This breaks the original behavior where 'index.html' was also considered home. If the path is 'index.html', is.home will return false now, breaking existing behavior and tests.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original condition to `if (!this.path || this.path === 'index.html') return true;` to correctly identify the home path.

rawFindings.title: Regex in isHomeHelper no longer allows 'index.html' suffix
rawFindings.explanation: The RegExp cached in regexCache.home[paginationDir] lost support for matching optional 'index.html' suffix at the end. The original regex allowed paths like 'page/2/index.html' to be considered home, but the new regex doesn't, likely causing incorrect results.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original regex to `new RegExp('^' + escapeRegExp(paginationDir) + '\/\d+\/(index\.html)?$')` to preserve previous behavior.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect behavior for home path check with 'index.html'
rawFindings.explanation: The original code returned true when the path is empty or equals 'index.html', but the updated code only returns true when the path is empty, which breaks the condition that 'index.html' path is considered home.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the check to include path === 'index.html' as a home path, e.g. if (!this.path || this.path === 'index.html') return true;

rawFindings.title: Regular expression for pagination directory in isHomeHelper is incomplete
rawFindings.explanation: The regex was changed from '^paginationDir\/\d+\/(index\.html)?$' to '^paginationDir\/\d+\/' which removes the optional 'index.html' suffix and the end-of-string anchor. This loosens the matching and can introduce false positives.
rawFindings.suggestion: Keep the original regex pattern with the optional 'index.html' and end anchor to match expected pagination paths precisely.
